typeIdent.description:
Indicates explicit sub-type of entry.  Composed of the concatenation of the typeKey of the instance's type and all
of its base type's typeIdent

id.description:
A unique identifier that can be manually assigned or generated automatically during object creation. This
identifier cannot be altered after the object has been persisted.

version.description:
Version number used for optimistic concurrency.  Automatically managed by the system.

Updating an Obj with a null or 0 value for version will cause the concurrency check to be skipped and should only
be done with great caution.

typeWithBindings.description: Persists concrete type with bindings for generic types where instance has parameter bindings

file.description:
A reference to a file associated with the setup process.
This could be any type of file, such as configuration files, model input files, or data files,
depending on the specific setup task.

actionRequirement.description:
A serialized string representing the action requirement for the setup.
The action requirement defines the conditions or tasks that need to be fulfilled in order
for the setup to be completed successfully. This is typically a serialized action from the Action module.

title:
Represents a setup configuration within the context of machine learning or reliability modeling.
This entity stores a file, an action requirement, and the setup function that manages the
setup process related to machine learning or system reliability tasks.

For details on other information stored in this Type, refer to the documentation on each of the fields of this Type.
name: ReliabilityMl.Setup
